Global growth is broadening, and business activity is picking up. The Chief Investment Office (CIO) believes 2026 will be shaped by supportive fiscal conditions, rising earnings and an accelerating AI‑industrial investment cycle. “Recently we’ve experienced above-average volatility across the markets,” says Chris Hyzy, Chief Investment Officer for Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank. “This volatility has pressured metals prices and high-growth mega-cap shares as well. In the context of all of this, we’re focusing on six key portfolio considerations we believe matter most this year.” 

For more insights into today’s markets from Merrill and the Chief Investment Office, visit Today's Markets: Stock Market Research and Insights. https://www.ml.com/financial-research-and-insights/todays-markets.html

What matters most for investors in 2026?

IG’s Senior Investment Analyst Angeline Ong is joined by Julian Wheeler – Partner and US Equity Specialist at Shard Capital to break down long term investment themes and short term trading opportunities shaping global markets.

The discussion covers how investors are positioning after a volatile start to the year, where value and momentum are emerging, and how to think about duration, risk and timing across different asset classes.

Key topics include:
 • Long term investment ideas versus short term opportunities
 • Retail and consumer trends through Costco
 • Energy transition plays including solar and aluminium
 • Rotation across US equities and sector leadership
 • When to take profits and how to manage duration
 • High momentum stocks and managing volatility

This episode combines strategic investing with practical market insight, helping investors think clearly about where opportunities may lie in 2026.
